title: Ministry of Social and Family Development
what_it_is: Ministry of Social and Family Development

sections.label: Affordable quality early childhood services
sections.summary: It states plans to ensure access to affordable, quality early childhood services, targeting places for 80% of preschoolers in Government-supported preschools by end-2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: For families with young children, we will ensure access to affordable and quality early childhood (EC) services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are on track to offer places for 80% of preschoolers in Government-supported preschools by the end of 2025 and will continue to keep pre-school affordable while expanding infant care options.

sections.label: Supporting caregivers and vulnerable adults
sections.summary: It states support for caregivers to stay in or return to employment, and a review of the Mental Capacity Act and Lasting Powers of Attorney safeguards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will support caregivers in looking after loved ones and help them stay in or return to employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will review the Mental Capacity Act to better support families with vulnerable adults who lack mental capacity, while strengthening safeguards against misuse or abuse of the Lasting Powers of Attorney.

sections.label: ComLink+ family coaches and ComCare
sections.summary: It states that ComLink+ family coaches and volunteer befrienders help families set and achieve goals, with Progress Packages, KidSTART and ComCare improvements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Through ComLink+, dedicated family coaches and volunteer befrienders will journey alongside these families to set and achieve their goals, with Progress Packages providing additional financial support to recognise their efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will continue to invest in child development through KidSTART and help families with young children enrol in and attend preschools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will improve the experience of families who need ComCare assistance and regularly review and update ComCare payouts.

sections.label: Domestic violence and youth offending
sections.summary: It states MSF will enhance preventive interventions and strengthen the legal framework for protecting survivors through a new Domestic Violence Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To reduce the incidence of domestic violence and youth offending, MSF will enhance investments in preventive interventions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will also strengthen the legal framework for protecting survivors through a new Domestic Violence Act.

sections.label: Sustainable philanthropy and giving
sections.summary: It states efforts to grow organisations embracing the Sustainable Philanthropy Framework and amplify giving through SG SHARE and Community Chest.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will grow the number of organisations that embrace the Sustainable Philanthropy Framework and commit time, talent and treasure to build a more caring society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will amplify the contributions and impact of giving through SG SHARE and Community Chest, ensuring philanthropic efforts grow alongside the economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Strong families and meaningful opportunities grow from the support of communities, businesses and individuals working together.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will join hands with Singaporeans, in the spirit of Forward Singapore, to build a caring and inclusive future for all.
